inputs.name: hand over from CI/CD Pipeline to Canary and A/B Testing

output.level_0: Pipeline crashes before reaching canary, leaving production traffic completely uncontrolled and unpredictable.
output.level_1: No handover exists; developers push directly to production without any staged rollout mechanism.
output.level_2: Engineers manually trigger canary deployments via CLI scripts after pipeline completion, risking human error.
output.level_3: Pipeline automatically triggers canary releases and A/B splits based on predefined success criteria.
output.level_4: Governed handover enforces compliance checks, audit logs, and approval gates before canary traffic shifts.
